feedback.problem:
$$
A=[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 \\ 4 & 4 \\ 2 & 2 \\ 0 & 0\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}4 \\ 1 \\ -1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the matrix $A$ and vector $b$ above. If the normal equation corresponding to the system $Ax=b$ is given below, what is the value of $a+b+c?$

$$
[\begin{aligned}a & 21 \\ 21 & b\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}6 \\ c\end{aligned}]
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
The normal equation corresponding to $Ax=b$ is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}{A}^{T}\,Ax & ={A}^{T}b \\ [\begin{aligned}1 & 4 & 2 & 0 \\ 1 & 4 & 2 & 0\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 & 1 \\ 4 & 4 \\ 2 & 2 \\ 0 & 0\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 4 & 2 & 0 \\ 1 & 4 & 2 & 0\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}4 \\ 1 \\ -1 \\ 0\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}21 & 21 \\ 21 & 21\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}6 \\ 6\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
a+b+c=21+21+6=48.
$$
